text: We are married couple and I couldn't go to Israel for a year and a half since the application was submitted bc this was how long it took them to process the application. When my husband complained about the process to the clerk, she said had he married an Israeli, he wouldn't have had to go through that😂😂😂 my husband came to Serbia and we travelled, but Israel wasn't an option until the invitation came. Stay strong, the whole process is designed to break your relationship.
